|errata_history=This is errata version PC-E1 of [[Dengar (V) (Virtual Block 2)]]; it is the current text. No published image shows this text, so the image here is a CardMaker recreation of it ([[:File:VB2-10-Dengar-PC-E1-cardmaker.png]], made 8 November 2026). The Virtual Block 2 release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB2-10-Dengar.png]]) and the Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB2-D-dengar-pre.gif]]) show the original text; see [[Dengar (V) (Virtual Block 2)]].
* '''Original''' ([[Dengar (V) (Virtual Block 2)]]): text as given in the Virtual Block 2 release sheet (official text as of 7 December 2009): “Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots. Deploys free aboard Punishing One, and while piloting it, draws one battle destiny if unable to otherwise. At same site, Han's game text is canceled. May not be attacked. Immune to Fallen Portal.”.<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock2">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock2.pdf Virtual Block 2 release sheet] ("Official text as of 7 December 2009"). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261022152656/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock2.pdf Internet Archive]</ref> The Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013) prints this text again. That copy is a stale reprint, not a new version, because the PC website card list already showed the later text of [[Dengar (V) (Virtual Block 2) (Errata)]] (wiki versions ruling, 8 November 2026).<ref name="ml-ds">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_DS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Dark Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170704232650/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf Internet Archive]</ref>
* '''PC-E1''' (this page): The PC website card list (shown there by 21 July 2012, the earliest archived capture with text) removed “May not be attacked.”. PC-E1 text: “Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots. Deploys free aboard Punishing One, and while piloting it, draws one battle destiny if unable to otherwise. At same site, Han's game text is canceled. Immune to Fallen Portal.”<ref name="cl-1220_10-2012-07-21">Players Committee website card list (VBlock2Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064711/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock2Type.html 2012-07-21] (Internet Archive)</ref>
